summary.headline: Florentine Codex Astrological Index
summary.text: Description of a mutilated Florentine codex, including lost Iatromathematica and works attributed to Stephanus of Alexandria, Astrampsychus, Claudius Ptolemy, and Achmat the Persian. The folio index lists astrological chapters on astronomy, star naming, exaltations and depressions, zodiacal residence, chronocrators, Critodemus’s terms, decans, and Persian star powers and colors.
